descFull: On-prem/LAN Layer 2 & 4 availability monitoring with realtime guarantees & decaying alert pacing.  Multithreaded high speed availability checking for SNMP, PING, TCP/UDP, QUIC & HTTP/S resources incl. SSL/TLS cert. pinning & port MAC address pinning. Integrates w/Site24x7 heartbeat monitoring for failover alerts + MRTG + Slack & Pushover webhooks.
